title: Common
description: Types shared by the Lug to Lug data contracts. Lengths are in millimetres and colours are sRGB.

Colour.description: An sRGB colour as lower-case hex, for drawing

ColourName.description: A colour as a source or a person names it

CaseShape.description: The case outline seen from above. 'square' covers rectangular cases too

CaseMaterial.description: What the case is made of; gold covers yellow, rose and white gold, told apart by colour

StrapType.description: What the watch is worn on

CrownPosition.description: Where the crown sits, as an hour on the dial (3 for most watches, 9 for a left-hand crown)

SourceId.description: A source's ID in the catalogue's source list (S0001, S0002, ...)
